narrative_intent: Maya addresses the camera directly; we learn her situation before the plot starts moving.

action: Maya stands at the counter, looks straight into the lens, and speaks one short line without moving her hands.
lighting: soft overcast window light from camera-left, weak bounce fill from a white card on the right
style_grade: naturalistic handheld documentary, slightly desaturated, fine film grain, no stylization

entities.name: Maya

entities.expression_cues: blinks once before speaking, keeps both hands flat on the counter
